name: techdella/bar-chart
title: Bar chart
description: A simple horizontal bar chart for one series (shares, rankings, survey results), with a named source. Accessible: every value is printed.

attributes.title: Where B2B buyers start research (example data)

techdella.help: items: 3–8 {label, value} of ONE measure, largest first. unit: "%", "$" or a word. max: the scale maximum (default: the largest value; use 100 for percentages). highlight: index of the one bar shown in orange (-1 = none). Always name the source.
